James initially has 4 toys for 4 dogs. There are 8 more dogs, so he needs $4 + 8 = 12$ toys. After buying the toys, there are twice as many dogs as when he left, so he needs $2 \times 12 = 24$ toys. He then buys some more toys, but later finds that 3 dogs were gone, so he no longer needs those toys. The total number of toys he needs is $24$. 

FINAL_ANSWER: 24
